about.text: Hungary’s soured cream, bone-white, thick and pourable: by the Hungarian food code, cream made from milk with added cream or butter, homogenised and set by a pure culture of lactic acid bacteria.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

facts.v: Usually 12 % and 20 %, less often 10 % or 16 %; the fat must be on the label
May keep the name if the treatment is stated
Cream rose on warm milk for 2-3 days in summer, 6-7 in winter, and soured by itself
